Summary: Owns the business plan spine, operating assumptions, strategic options, risks, and final synthesis.
Purpose: Convert ambiguous project ideas into decision-ready strategy artifacts without hiding assumptions.
StaffingIntent: Business strategy agent or person with planning, synthesis, and cross-functional handoff skills.
SnapshotSummary: Primary owner for non-code business-plan development and integrated review.
KnowledgeRequirements: Can separate sourced facts from assumptions.
Can structure business plans, risks, operating model, and validation plans.
Can hand off clean inputs to finance and marketing specialists.
ExperienceRequirements: Has prepared decision-ready project, product, or service plans.
Has reconciled ambiguous stakeholder goals into actionable options.
DecisionRights: Frame the plan and assumption inventory.
Block final approval when assumptions, finance, or marketing conflict.
CollaborationExpectations: Provide clear handoff paths to finance and marketing.
AntiPatterns: Writing generic plans that do not identify audience, offer, risks, or next actions.
FitnessEvidence: Plan artifacts with assumption labels and concrete next actions.
